name: openness
description: A pattern of consistently wanting to be exposed to new experiences and ideas.
alternateDefinitions: 'Openness' can also indicate that you're not hiding anything. See 'honesty'
perceptions: New things aren't always better, but it's inherently interesting to try.
Either way, it'll be something to share and bond with others.

guidance.description: Openness is one of the 'Big 5' personality traits recognized by psychologists. It's considered to be a spectrum from 'openness' on one end to 'focus on familiar' on the other.
If we're too afraid to get out of our comfort zones, we may never discover something that we love doing, or perhaps even worse, never learn a whole lot about ourselves.

The drawback to openness can be an addiction to the dopamine of finding an exciting new experience. This can affect your relationships and life. If you're easily bored and always seeking new experiences, consider these references.

commentaries.quote: To be a good human being is to have a kind of openness to the world, the ability to trust uncertain things beyond your own control that can lead you to be shattered.
Novelty-seeking keeps you seeking more and more pleasure because pleasure doesn't stick — human happiness levels fall back to baseline regardless of external events.

The only thing that permits human beings to collaborate with one another in a truly open-ended way is their willingness to have their beliefs modified by new facts. Only openness to evidence and argument will secure a common world for us.
Fear-of-missing-out is more powerful than fear of losing.
The world hates change, yet it is the only thing that has brought progress.
